title: The value of not getting to the point (2015)
summary: A reflective blog post exploring why indirect communication and taking time to build context before reaching the main point can be more valuable than immediate directness. The author argues that not getting to the point allows for better understanding, engagement, and meaningful connections with the audience.
problem_solved: Challenges the modern obsession with brevity by demonstrating the value of elaborate, context-rich communication.
why_valuable: Offers a counterpoint to 'TL;DR' culture, suggesting that patience in communication leads to deeper understanding and more meaningful discourse.
